marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Wind light increasing to northwest 15 knots near midnight and to
northwest 20 near noon Sunday. Wind increasing to northwest 30 early Sunday
evening. Showers this evening. Showers Sunday morning. Fog
dissipating late overnight. <br/>

evening.<br/>
